Figure 2: Overview of our framework. Training involves three stages: 1) SFT and rule-based GRPO for the VLM agent; 2) SFT for the mask-conditioned editor; and 3) multi-round joint RL guided by an external VLM judge. During inference, the agent and editor interact in a closed loop, iteratively executing masked visual prompts and refining results until the instruction is complete.
